title: Error shape (frozen v0.1)
description: What a client may show or log about a failure. Status: FROZEN v0.1 (Phase 03, 2026-10-20). `message` is plain-word, bounded and written for the learner; raw provider payloads, stack traces, secrets and learner content are rejected by the explicit false schemas below. `category` is the stable machine contract; `code` is a finer stable identifier. `retryable` is true only for transient conditions — client mistakes must never be offered as auto-retryable. `not_available` is the category a frozen-but-unimplemented seam answers with: it is never retryable, because retrying does not make the seam exist.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. provider.unavailable. Not shown to learners.

category.description: Stable category for client logic and support docs. `not_available` marks a frozen seam that is not implemented yet (the Phase 03 stub behaviour); it is never retryable.

message.description: Plain-word, learner-facing message. Never a stack trace, raw provider dump, secret or learner content.

retryable.description: True only when retrying could genuinely succeed (transient network/provider/service states).
